'''Spooky:) LSC MK II:)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Spooky:)]]
* '''Published:''' 23 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WHT Spooky) LS 2003 LSCMKII 4661.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my LSC but with little upgrade's:)

The published list has 54 cards.

== Strategy ==

The strategy is veary simple...

you need to hold the initiative and make your

opponent to react for your moves. There are only 2 naboo sites in this deck

so when your opponent deploys a dark jedi he has no place to run from yor Qui Gon:)

He is a key figure becous he add's 2 to force loss when he weins a combat

so he makes up for your force drain:) and it's even beter becous force lost comes from

reaserved deck and cannot be reduced or canceled:) after 2-3 won combats you have the

game in hand:) becous your opponent need to deploy card's and will have some in his

hand so he can't use them in life force:) so loss of 8-12 force is veary painful:)

the next thing is I Did It. with high forfeit value dark side needs to deploy

some good amount of power to overcome you and that cost's a lot of force:)

and i did it makes sure that he need's to lose some force and on the other

hand i did it let's you to retrive 4 force from unuseful bonta eve podrace:)

this allowes you to retrive force lost from Target the main power generator when

you will not have it could be worse:) When dark side deploys to you and start a

battle be happy use Jedi Focus to not allow use of lightsabers then use Higher Ground

to cancel opponent battle destiny and last use smoke screnn so you have a nice 7 and

dark side has non hehe good?:) Jar Jar is handy when opponent has no battleground's you

may deploy to:) and allways he may try to stick to some pesky bounty hunter or a droid:)

Playing ageainst Huntdown and Dark Combat i this case the best thing you can do is wait

and react to opponent moves:) and do not count on combat card's insted you need to track

destiny useing depa to track it:) As for the defensive shield's be sure to use

The Tragedy Has Accured , and anti SAC shields:) I'v palyed this deck few thimes and the

only game i lost i'v played dar senat build just for defiting me with about 5 mauls and

half deck of 7 destiny card's:)
